name: Reynolds Transport Theorem for Differentiable Rendering
aliases: Differentiable Rendering via Reynolds Transport Theorem
definition: A method to compute the derivative of a rendering integral with respect to scene parameters by decomposing it into an interior term (derivative of the continuous integrand) and a boundary term (integral over discontinuities).
summary: Reynolds Transport Theorem for Differentiable Rendering computes gradients by decomposing the rendering integral into interior and boundary terms, explicitly handling geometric discontinuities unlike standard rasterization methods.
